title: phaeneilema koenigii
intro: Phaeneilema koenigii, commonly known as the Indian bay leaf or curry leaf tree, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant is used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine and has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of P. koenigii include its use as an antiseptic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-emetic agent, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion. The bioactive constituents of P. koenigii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
